Dear Kanishka,

I'm sorry for whatever I did. I never meant to make things harder for you, and it hurts to think that I might have.

I care about you, and I always will, no matter what. That doesn't depend on how things are between us right now.

I'm not asking for things to go back to how they were. I only want you to know that I'm still rooting for you, through every exam, every late night and every step toward the doctor you're becoming.

I hope you can forgive me, whenever you're ready. If you can't, I understand.

I miss you so much.

Happy birthday, Kanishka.

with all my heart, Arnav
